events.verdict: Jackson Jr. (MIL) brushes Bridges' (CHA) left arm as he secures the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Ball's (CHA) driving shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two steps before his dunk.
Green (CHA) brushes Antetokounmpo's (MIL) right arm during his driving shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Bridges (CHA) drifts toward Antetokounmpo (MIL) as he contests the driving shot attempt, and the body contact that occurs between the two is marginal.

Williams (CHA) establishes screening position in Wright's (MIL) path and allows a step of distance during the pick. Wright then attempts to move over the pick, and marginal contact occurs with Williams' left thigh.

Replay review of the foul called on Prince (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Prince does not establish a legal guarding position in Ball's (CHA) path prior to the start of Ball's upward shooting motion during the driving shot attempt.
Connaughton (MIL) moves alongside Ball's (CHA) path toward the basket when marginal body contact occurs on the driving shot attempt.
Ball's (CHA) left foot dislodges the ball prior to incidental contact occurring with Antetokounmpo (MIL) on the perimeter.
The ball goes out of bounds off Ball's (CHA) left foot.
Green (CHA) adjusts alongside Connaughton's (MIL) path and marginal body contact occurs as Connaughton drifts away for the driving shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position along Ball's (CHA) path and Ball loses his footing on his own accord.
Green (CHA) extends his arm into Connaughton's (MIL) back and delivers body contact as Connaughton attempts to secure the pass
Williams (CHA) legally contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
